name: freightchain-monorepo
description: Freight Chain – frontend/client/ (the game + lobby, vanilla ES modules + three.js), frontend/landing/ (the / page, Vite) and backend/server/ (NestJS, Prisma, PostgreSQL; serves both). Each has its own package.json; these scripts just delegate.

scripts.server:dev: sh -c 'set -a; [ -f infra/deploy/local/dev.env ] && . ./infra/deploy/local/dev.env; set +a; npm --prefix backend/server run start:dev'
scripts.check: npm run client:check && npm --prefix frontend/client run test:parity && npm --prefix frontend/client run test:tickets-stub && node .claude/skills/test-census/census.mjs --self-test && npm run landing:lint && npm run landing:build && npm run landing:test && npm run server:build && npm run server:typecheck && npm run server:test && npm run mcp:check && npm run media:check
scripts.entities:export: npm --prefix backend/server run build && npm --prefix backend/server run entities:export
scripts.media:check: npm --prefix social/media run lint && npm --prefix social/media test
scripts.build: npm run landing:build && npm run server:build
scripts.editor:worker: sh -c 'set -a; [ -f infra/deploy/local/dev.env ] && . ./infra/deploy/local/dev.env; set +a; npm --prefix backend/server run editor:worker'
